**Have you checked [PHASES.md](../../PHASES.md) and [DOCUMENTATION.md](../../DOCUMENTATION.md) §1.4/§3 first?** A lot of "obvious next steps" are already tracked there as known limitations or roadmap items - if yours is, feel free to just say so and add anything the existing writeup is missing, rather than re-explaining the whole idea from scratch.

## What problem does this solve?

Describe the gap or limitation this addresses - a false negative you hit, a workflow this tool doesn't support, a signal it doesn't detect, etc.

## Proposed solution

What you'd want the tool to do instead. If you have a specific implementation approach in mind, sketch it - but a rough idea is fine too.

## Alternatives considered

Any other approaches you thought about, and why this one seems best.

## Would you be willing to implement this?

Let us know if you're planning to open a PR yourself - see [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) for dev setup and conventions.
